messages:
alex: Quick pre-canary sync — can someone confirm a few things before I flip the flag for eu-west tomorrow morning?
- weights location that we pinned for the new 30B variant
- tokenizer quirks (emoji split / unk behavior on long contexts) — any recent fixes?
- RoPE scaling + GQA/MQA flags validated for sliding-window mode?

priya: I validated weights path and pushed an alias. weights are at s3://redwood-model-artifacts/variants/mistral30b/rw-weights-v3.tar (alias mistral30b-rw:v3) :thumbsup:
I also uploaded a small integrity patch (sha256: d4f9a2c3).

jonathan: Noted on weights. Tokenizer: still seeing an edge with emoji + ZWJ sequences when seq_len > 2048 — it splits into multiple unknown tokens. I filed a tiny patch in the tokenizer lib (PR #482) but haven't merged because of one failing test on RTL whitespace.

tegan: For RoPE/GQA/MQA: my config lint run shows we have mismatch between the runtime config and the model card. Runtime sets `rope_scale: 1.0` and `pos_emb_stride: 1` while the model card expects `rope_scale: 1.03` and `pos_emb_stride: 2` for correct cross-attention alignment. If we leave it at 1.0 we get subtle hallucination drift after ~1k tokens in GQA mode.

alex: That's the risk I was worried about. Is the `pos_emb_stride` change something we can toggle via model-variant only (no binary change)?

tegan: Yes, it's just inference config flags — no runtime build required. But we need to run a quick canary with both GQA and MQA enabled and compare logits/nll on the small eval set. I have a canary job prepared: `canary/mistral30b/rw-v3-euw-test`

infra-bot: Canary job queued: canary/mistral30b/rw-v3-euw-test — id cjob-20250302-77b — status: queued.

jonathan: I can take the tokenizer patch and rebase; will try to keep the RTL fix minimal. If merged, we should re-generate tokenizer artifacts at /mnt/models/tokenizers/mistral30b/tokenizer.json and bump the manifest.

priya: Re: weights integrity — I ran a quick forward-pass smoke on a 512 token prompt (local q8 runtime) and outputs look fine; latency within expected range. Command I ran: 
```
curl -s -X POST https://internal-api.redwood/canary/run -d '{"model":"mistral30b-rw:v3","prompt":"The quick brown fox","max_tokens":64}'
```
Output trimmed, no OOMs.

tegan: For the RoPE/pos stride test, run with these flags in the model variant override: 
```
rope_scale: 1.03
pos_emb_stride: 2
gqa_enabled: true
mqa_enabled: true
sliding_window: true
sliding_window_chunk: 1024
```
I also recommend enabling `kv_prefetch: true` for the canary to simulate production batching.

alex: Perfect. jonathan — can you rebase tokenizer PR and post the new artifact path here once it's uploaded? I'll wait for that before promoting the canary from queued -> running.

jonathan: On it. ETA ~45m. I'll upload to staging path: s3://redwood-model-artifacts/variants/mistral30b/tokenizers/tokenizer-v2.json and update manifest PR #489.

infra-bot: canary/mistral30b/rw-v3-euw-test — status: running. cjob-20250302-77b

priya: Running eval harness now. Quick note: if the tokenizer change changes tokenization counts, our cost projections for canary need to be re-run (embedding and generation token counts differ). I'll re-run cost script after jonathan uploads artifact.

jonathan: Uploaded tokenizer artifact and updated manifest in PR #489. Path: s3://redwood-model-artifacts/variants/mistral30b/tokenizers/tokenizer-v2.json — sha256: a1b2c3d4.

tegan: Thanks — I kicked an eval with the pos_emb_stride/rope_scale flags and kv_prefetch enabled. First pass shows NLL delta drops by ~0.8% on the GQA eval (good), and sliding-window latency is +12ms per request but 22% better throughput with batching.

alex: That looks safe to me. Any blockers on the RTL tokenizer test?

jonathan: Fixed the RTL edge — merged PR #482 and bumped tokenizer in manifest. Added one unit test for the ZWJ emoji sequence.

infra-bot: canary/mistral30b/rw-v3-euw-test — status: succeeded. cjob-20250302-77b — logs: https://ci.redwood/canary/cjob-20250302-77b/logs

priya: Canary results: no regressions on our sampling-based QA, latency within SLA, tokenization aligned with manifest. Cost delta negligible. I recommend promoting to canary->gradual rollout over next 2 hours with fallback to mistral30b-rw:v2 if error rate crosses 0.5%.

tegan: I'll prepare the rollout policy in the console: set `canary_percent: 5`, `step_interval: 30m`, `fallback_model: mistral30b-rw:v2`, and `slo_error_threshold: 0.5`.

alex: Great. I'll schedule the promotion at 0800 UTC. Thanks everyone — if no objections I will flip the flag then. :eyes:

jonathan: No objections from me. Thanks for coordinating.

priya: Go for it. I'll watch metrics. :thumbsup:

alex: Rolling at 0800 UTC. Will ping in #eng-runtime with final status after the first step.
